extractionMethod.note: Read directly, single-page rates table with three parallel currency sub-tables (KES/USD/EUR) plus a separate single-page policy sheet.

structuralFindings: Base rate table currency is quoted in THREE parallel currencies (KES, USD, EUR) for the same date rows and room — not one primary currency with conversions noted; USD used as primary here since that matches the project's general convention, but KES and EUR figures are equally 'confirmed' (all three appear on the same source page).
Base meal plan Bed & Breakfast only — 'The only formula we operate with is Bed and Breakfast' stated explicitly. No Half Board/Full Board/All Inclusive option exists at all for this property.

Base rates in the main table (SGL/DBL/PP/3rd-4th bed) are explicitly for the Standard Garden View Suite only — all other room categories are priced as a flat SUPPLEMENT added on top of this base rate, not as independent rate columns like every other property in this batch.
10 date-range rows per currency table, non-uniform lengths (irregular high/low season windows tied to Kenyan coast tourist season, not a simple Peak/Shoulder/Green 3-tier).
Minimum stay varies by row (1, 2, or 4 nights) — tied to season, not a flat policy.
Children under 2 free; 1 adult + 1 child above 2yrs charged as two adults (i.e. no child discount at all past age 2 — a notably harsher policy than every other property in this batch).
Late check-out (until 6pm) costs a flat fee: 8,000 KES / 80 USD / 75 EUR.

Cancellation policy: full non-refundable amount withheld on cancellation or no-show; a voucher (12-month validity) is issued instead if cancelled 14+ days before arrival. Different terms may apply for 2+ room bookings (unspecified what those different terms are).

rates.unit: Standard Garden View Suite, Bed & Breakfast. SGL=single occupancy, DBL=double room total, PP=per person sharing, '3rd-4th bed ADT'=extra adult in room, '3rd-4th bed CHD'=extra child in room.

roomSupplements.note: Added on top of the Standard Garden View Suite base rate above, per person per night presumably (unit not explicitly re-stated on the supplement line, inferred to match the base rate's per-person-per-night unit).
